table_description: Customer orders with status tracking. Each order belongs to one user and contains one or more order items.
data_quality_notes: total_amount is DECIMAL(12,2) — sum of (quantity * unit_price) for all order items
total_amount is pre-calculated and stored (not computed on the fly)
To exclude cancelled orders from revenue, filter WHERE status != 'Cancelled'

table_columns.name: status
table_columns.description: Order status: Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled
